Every `upnext auth` command and its help, as `--help` prints it. Each also accepts the [global flags](/commands#global-flags).

## `upnext auth`

```text
DESCRIPTION
  Sign in to a source that needs it

USAGE
  upnext auth [flags] <source>

ARGUMENTS
  source choice    The source to sign in to: twitch or youtube

INHERITED FLAGS
  --socket string    Path to the daemon socket (default: $UPNEXT_SOCK, then $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/upnext/upnext.sock)
```
